title: Import from Beszel
subtitle: Bring your servers, alerts and notification channels over from Beszel.
linkHint: Coming from Beszel? Import its servers, alerts, channels and history.

connect.title: Connect to Beszel
connect.desc: Sign in with the account you use in Beszel. Nothing there is changed.
connect.keep: Keep these credentials for later syncs
connect.keepHelp: Off by default: they are encrypted and deleted when the import finishes.

err.badCredentials: Beszel did not accept that email and password.
err.notBeszel: That address does not look like a Beszel hub.
err.unreachable: Tugra could not reach Beszel at that address.
err.mfa: This account needs a second factor. Use an account without one for the import.
err.forbidden: This account is not allowed to read Beszel's data.

review.title: Review
review.desc: Nothing is imported until you press Import.

systems.title: Servers
systems.desc: Beszel's systems, matched to your Tugra servers by address or name.
systems.noServers: Add the server to Tugra first, then preview again.

unmatched.none: No Tugra server has this address or name.
unmatched.ambiguous: More than one Tugra server fits. Pick one.
unmatched.duplicate: Another Beszel system already matches that server.
unmatched.socket: This is the Beszel hub's own box, reached over a socket.

alerts.title: Alert rules
alerts.desc: Become metric monitors that watch each server once a minute.
alerts.none: Beszel has no alert rules for this login.
alerts.coveredHelp: Tugra already alerts when a server goes offline.
alerts.approx: Beszel averages over the window. Tugra alerts after that many one-minute checks in a row.

skip.cpuState: CPU I/O wait and steal alerts are not supported.
skip.network: Network monitor alerts are not carried.
skip.smart: Disk health alerts are not carried.
skip.other: This alert type is not supported.

channels.title: Notification channels
channels.desc: Beszel's notification URLs become Tugra channels.
channels.none: Beszel has no notification URLs for this login.

skip.invalidUrl: This URL could not be read.
skip.unsupportedService: Tugra has no channel for this service yet.
skip.unsupportedAuth: Sign-in details on this URL are not supported.
skip.unsupportedBot: Only incoming webhooks are supported, not bot tokens.

note.genericPayload: Tugra sends its own webhook format, so the receiver may need adjusting.

channels.emails: {n} email addresses in Beszel are not imported. Add an email channel in Tugra and attach it to the monitors.

history.title: History
history.desc: The last {days} days of CPU, memory, disk, network and load.
history.none: Nothing new to import. Tugra already has this period or Beszel has none.
history.note: Temperature history and per-container history stay in Beszel. Existing Tugra data is never overwritten.

apply.nothing: Pick at least one part to import.
apply.stale: Beszel or your team changed since the preview. Review it again.

result.title: Imported
result.monitors: {created} monitors created, {existing} already existed, {covered} covered by the built-in offline alert.

failure.rejected: Tugra refused it (for example a private address).

result.kept: Your Beszel credentials are kept, encrypted.
